name: Yeti
description: Platform for aggregating, correlating, and enriching threat intelligence observables in one repository.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      YETI_MONGODB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mongodb"
      YETI_REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/opt/yeti/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-mongodb:
    image: mongo:6
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongodb
    restart: unless-stopped
